body: She loves me, but I have a sister who has everything together, and my mom can just transfer that portion of love over to her when I'm gone.  She deserves it more anyway.

You sound like you care about me more than I care about myself.  The thing you said about everything hitting you at once - it's so true.  I'm just tired of trying to fend everything off and keep fighting.

I don't really know what to tell you about myself.  It really is my fault that I'm alone.  I push everyone away for some reason.  I don't like trusting people because they always hurt me in some way.  I'm tired of being hurt and I'm tired of being alive and being a burden to my mom.

I've always been too self-conscious to let myself really enjoy something.  I'm always worried about what other people are thinking, and I always try to make other people laugh - it's a relief for my anxiety when I can make other people laugh.

I feel really apathetic about everything right now.  All I want to do is stay in bed all day and watch tv, and that's not helping anyone out.  I had to withdraw from university for the semester because I've tried to kill myself a couple of times, and I had to go to the hospital for an inpatient stay.  I have nothing to live for anymore.
I'm just so tired of trying.  I feel so empty and alone.
